CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE

CALL  TO ORDER  Gil Hurtado,  Mayor  called  a Regular  City  Council  Meeting  to order  at

HOUSING  Following  the conclusion  of the Public  Hearing,  the City  Council
  unanimously  approved  items A & B by motion  of Vice Mayor  Davila  and
  seconded  by Council  MemberAvalos:

  a.  Resolution  No. 2024-66-CC  entitled  A Resolution  of the City  Council
  of the City  of South  Gate, California,  approving  the Fiscal  Year 2023-
  2024 Consolidated  Annual  Performance  and Evaluation  Report
  ("CAPER");  and

  b.  Authorizing  the City  Manager,  or designee,  to submit  to the U.S.
  Department  of Housing  and Urban  Development  the Fiscal  Year 2023-
  2024 CAPER.

  Carol Averell,  Housing  Manager  gave a presentation.

  Mayor  Hurtado  asked if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak on this
  item.  He also asked if any emails  were received.  Seeing  no one step
  forward  nor any emails  received;  Mayor  Hurtado  closed  the audience
  portion.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  Member  Avalos,  yes; Council  Member  Barron,
  yes; Council  Member  Rios, yes; Vice Mayor  Davila,  yes; Mayor  Hurtado,
  yes.
